hero.headline: After-hours office cleaning in Greensboro, NC.
hero.sub: Your staff leaves at five. We come in at six, clean to a checklist, lock up and set the alarm. In the morning there's a log of every room we did.

owner.name: Tanya Reeves
owner.story: I started in 2012 cleaning two dental offices at night while my kids slept. Now there are fourteen of us. Every building has its own crew, and I meet every new client at their door before we take a key.
owner.shot: Shot list: Tanya at a client's front desk at dusk, key ring in hand, lobby lights on.

faq.q: How much does office cleaning cost in Greensboro?
faq.a: Most small offices land between a few hundred and a couple thousand dollars a month, depending on square feet, nights per week and restrooms. We bid after a free walkthrough and put the price in writing.

faq.q: How do you handle keys and alarm codes?
faq.a: Keys are logged and kept on a numbered ring, never labelled with your address. Each crew gets its own alarm code so you can see who came and went.
Yes, every cleaner, before their first key. We're also bonded and insured, and we send a certificate of insurance before we start.
No. Month to month with 30 days notice to stop.
Yes. We bring chemicals, equipment and liners. Restroom paper and soap can be ours or yours; we restock either way.
